TRANSPARENCY

The context matters.

How this publication handles coverage, commercial relationships and the limits of a video companion.

Last updated Oct 2, 2026

Video companions

These pages help you navigate published AutoTech Review videos. They identify the vehicle and format, connect related coverage and add buying checklists. They do not invent test results, scores, ownership experience or driving impressions.

Access and sponsorship

A dealership visit, filming permission, review loan, gifted product, affiliate relationship and paid campaign are different arrangements. A known relationship should be identified in the relevant coverage. If the source catalogue does not document it, this website labels it unconfirmed.

Paid content

Paid campaigns should be disclosed clearly. A brand may check factual accuracy within an agreed scope; payment or vehicle access does not guarantee a positive opinion. Commercial deliverables and editorial conditions are agreed before production.

Affiliate links

A qualifying affiliate link may earn a commission. It should be identified near the link. This version of the website does not add affiliate shopping links.

Canada and U.S. differences

Trim names, equipment, prices, currency, warranties and availability may vary by market and model year. A Canadian video is not automatically a description of a U.S. vehicle.

Facts and currency

The structured video collection checks for channel uploads every hour and rebuilds video pages, RSS and sitemaps when content changes. The homepage and video libraries also check the channel feed on opening and every five minutes while visible. Provider delays can affect timing. When YouTube is unavailable, saved coverage stays available. A new upload with an unconfirmed format appears in the full library while format detection retries. Audience figures are dated and rounded. This version does not claim to show live pricing or specifications.

Corrections

To flag an error, email autotechreview51@gmail.com with the page address and the detail that needs correcting. Material corrections should be identified when the page is updated.
